title: Sukkah 7b — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 7 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-007.htm), questions 3, 5–6.

questions.q: Do the walls of a sukkah need to provide shade (i.e. does the sun/shade rule count sunlight leaking through wall-gaps)?
options: Only if they don't reach the sechach
questions.explain: The Rabbis hold only sechach-driven sunlight counts; Rabbi Yoshiya, deriving from the Ark's curtain being called "sechach," holds wall-driven sunlight counts too — a real machloket.

questions.q: "Sukkah dirat keva be'ina" (a sukkah must be a permanent-feeling dwelling).
options: Only to permit carrying in it on Shabbos
questions.explain: Abaye's list shows a wide range of Tannaim converging on this intuition at different thresholds — but it isn't a flat universal rule; other positions and narrower applications remain live.

questions.q: May one build a sukkah on a ship?
options: We're concerned they may get seasick
As long as it's within 4 amos of the coast
questions.explain: Rabban Gamliel deems a boat-sukkah unfit; Rabbi Akiva deems it fit — a direct machloket, resolved (per Tosfos) around whether the structure can withstand an ordinary sea-wind.
